chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
There should be between the two wells, if the land is solid, five hundred cubits; and if it is loose, then one thousand cubits.

key_terms.أَرْضًا: land or ground in which the wells are situated
key_terms.الْبِئْرَيْنِ: the two wells between which a regulated distance is set
key_terms.خَمْسُمِائَةِ: five hundred, the required measure in solid land
key_terms.ذِرَاعٍ: a cubit, the unit of length used in the ruling
key_terms.فَأَلْفُ: then one thousand, the required measure in loose land

ai.seo_question: What is the required distance between two wells in solid and loose land according to the Imam (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the required distance between two wells. The required separation varies according to the nature of the land: less distance in solid ground and more in loose ground.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "There should be a distance of five hundred cubits between two wells if the land is solid, and one thousand cubits if the land is loose."
